ModMetaData.name: JB Framework Sample B
ModMetaData.author: Julius Berger
ModMetaData.description: Test and example mod for JB Framework (a dependent mod, test bed of the in-game harness). Not for players. Per-save values, a counter saved through the framework (KitRegistry.SaveData), one item def, legacy settings migration and one own test suite. Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested.
